title: send_web_app_custom_request leaves its custom_requests entry when the send is refused
trigger: A mini app invokes a custom method while the client refuses the send (closing client); the entry keyed by the reserved request id is inserted before send_json_request and never removed on Err
effect: A dead (launch_id, req_id) entry stays in web_apps.custom_requests for the life of the session; the app never gets an error for that req_id
fix: Insert after the send succeeds, or remove the entry in the Err arm; better, hold the req_id in the pending request itself

title: A refused public-forwards send leaves the forwards list Idle with no failure or Retry
trigger: Open a post's statistics while the sender refuses the second send (getMessagePublicForwards); fetch_message_public_forwards returns the error via `?` before forwards_requested, and the caller discards it with `let _ =`
effect: The statistics load but the public-forwards section never fills and offers no Retry; only reopening the page asks again
fix: Mark forwards Failed (as send_failed does for wallet lists) when the send is refused
